enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Eyes closed. Breathes deeply. Turns to left. Pulls blanket. Turns to right. Snores. Turns to back. Stretches legs. Remains asleep. Turns to left again. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Scrub hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and tea using the toaster and kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open cupboard. Take bread. Open bread bag. Take two slices. Put slices in toaster. Press lever down. Open cupboard. Take mug. Take tea bag. Put tea bag in mug. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Wait for toaster. Toast pops up. Remove toast. Put on plate. Open fridge. Take butter. Spread butter on toast. Kettle boils. Pour hot water into mug. Add milk. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Finish. Stand up. Put plate and mug in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the room and planning the day's study tasks on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up clothes from floor. Fold clothes. Put clothes in wardrobe. Make bed. Pull up blanket. Flatten pillow. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Check schedule. Type tasks. Set reminders. Put phone on desk. Stand up. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying Master of Education coursework and reading journal articles on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Enter password. Open browser. Navigate to university portal. Download article. Open PDF. Scroll down. Read. Highlight text. Copy quote. Open word processor. Paste quote. Type notes. Save file. Continue reading. Highlight another section. Type more notes. Stretch arms. Save file again.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a simple lunch with the induction cooker and rice cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Open fridge. Take vegetables. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Open rice cooker. Add rice. Add water. Close lid. Turn on rice cooker. Wait. Stir vegetables. Turn off induction cooker. Plate vegetables. Open rice cooker. Scoop rice into bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up chopsticks. Pick up bowl. Eat rice. Pick up vegetables. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Clear dishes. Put dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lean back. Cross legs. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Watch TV. Stand up. Turn off TV. Walk away.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry and running a load in the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open laundry basket. Sort clothes into piles. Pick up pile. Open washing machine. Put clothes in. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Turn dial. Press start button. Wait for machine to start. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping for the week at the local supermarket
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to supermarket. Enter store. Take trolley. Push trolley. Walk to aisle. Pick up item. Check price. Put in trolley. Continue shopping. Pick up another item. Put in trolley. Go to checkout. Unload items onto belt. Pay cashier. Bag items. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and putting food away in the refrigerator and freezer
enriched_activities.desc: Place bags on counter. Open fridge. Take items from bag. Put items in fridge. Open freezer. Put frozen items in freezer. Close freezer. Close fridge. Open cupboard. Put dry goods in cupboard. Close cupboard. Break down bags. Throw bags in bin.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing a university assignment draft on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on. Open document. Read assignment prompt. Type heading. Write paragraph. Pause. Delete sentence. Retype. Check word count. Save document. Continue writing. Type more paragraphs. Save again.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a break, browsing study resources on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open browser. Search for study resources. Click link. Read. Scroll down. Save bookmark. Open another link. Read. Put phone down. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the oven and induction cooker with the range hood on
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on range hood. Preheat oven. Open fridge. Take ingredients. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Open oven. Place tray inside. Close oven. Set timer. Stir pan. Check oven. Turn off induction cooker. Take tray out of oven. Turn off oven. Turn off range hood.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Serve food. Pick up fork. Cut food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Finish meal. Push plate away. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the kitchen benches
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Add soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place in drying rack. Wash cup. Rinse cup. Place in rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place in rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe bench. Rinse cloth. Wring cloth. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and hanging up the laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Pick up laundry basket. Walk to drying rack. Hang clothes. Return to bathroom. Hang towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying course readings and preparing tutorial notes on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open reading. Read. Highlight text. Open tutorial document. Type notes. Save. Continue reading. Highlight more. Type more notes. Save again. Stretch. Read more. Type final notes. Save.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding with a TV show and a short game session on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select streaming service. Choose show. Watch TV. Pick up controller. Turn on game console. Play game. Pause game. Resume game. Turn off console. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting an alarm, checking messages on the phone and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm. Check messages. Reply to message. Put phone on nightstand. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
